meta.name: diffdock
meta.description: DiffDock and DiffDock-L molecular docking. Use for protein-small-molecule pose prediction from PDB or sequence plus SMILES/SDF/MOL2, batch docking, virtual screening, and pose-confidence interpretation. Not for binding affinity prediction.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 预测蛋白质与小分子的结合构象
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你是从事药物设计或结构生物学的科研人员
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are a researcher in drug design or structural biology

howto.what: Claude 会根据蛋白 PDB/序列和配体 SMILES/结构文件,用 DiffDock 预测小分子与蛋白结合的三维姿势并给置信度分数。支持单个、批量对接和虚拟筛选。不预测结合亲和力,需另用评分工具。
howto.when: 当你说“对接这个配体”“预测结合姿势”“做虚拟筛选”等分子对接相关请求,或提供蛋白 PDB/序列与配体 SMILES/结构文件时触发。批量对接同样支持。

say.text: 用这个蛋白 PDB 和配体 SMILES 做分子对接,输出置信度分数。
帮我批量对接 CSV 里的蛋白-配体对,并分析结果排名。
say.note: 会走批量模式并运行 analyze_results.py。

say.text: 这次对接置信度太低,把采样数量提高到 30 再跑。

howto.what_en: Predicts 3D ligand poses with DiffDock from PDB/sequence and SMILES/structure, outputting confidence scores. Supports single, batch, and virtual-screen docking. No affinity prediction; use scoring tools.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to dock a ligand, predict a pose, or run virtual screening, or provides a protein PDB/sequence plus a ligand SMILES/structure. Batch docking also supported.

say_en.text: Dock this ligand to this protein PDB using this SMILES, with confidence scores.
say_en.note: Claude runs inference and produces ranked pose files.

say_en.text: Batch-dock the complexes in this CSV and analyze the results.
Confidence is low; rerun with 30 samples per complex.
